wu: Warm-up: 'Flashcard Race' - Teacher shows flashcards of S1 vocab (animals, food, family), teams take turns shouting the word in English. Props: Flashcards, timer. Children stand in lines, race to say the word first. Teacher says 'Ready, set, go!'
wuAlt: Alternative 1: 'Simon Says' with S1 verbs (jump, run, draw) - Teacher says 'Simon says jump!' children jump.
Alternative 2: 'Number Bingo' - Teacher calls numbers 1-20, children cross off on bingo sheets.
pres: Presentation: 'Story Time' - Teacher reads a short story about a Moroccan family celebrating Eid. Props: Story flashcards (Eid, couscous, gifts). Model sentences: 'They were happy.' 'He gave a present.' Check understanding: 'Who was happy?' 'What did he give?'
presAlt: Alternative 1: 'Realia Show' - Show Moroccan objects (tagine, mint tea), say 'This is a tagine.' 'It is blue.'
Alternative 2: 'Picture Talk' - Show a picture of a Green March celebration, ask 'What do you see?'
prac: Guided Practice: 'Find the Pair' - Children match picture cards with word cards (S1 nouns). In pairs, they take turns saying 'This is a...' and 'It is a...'. Support: Teacher models first match, helps with pronunciation.
pracAlt: Alternative 1: 'Sentence Building' - Children use word cards to make sentences like 'I have a cat.'
Alternative 2: 'Roleplay Cards' - Pairs practice dialogues like 'What is this?' 'It is a book.'
ls: Listening Slot: 'Instruction Quiz' - Teacher reads 3-step instructions (e.g., 'Stand up, touch your nose, sit down'). Children do the actions. Checks comprehension by observing if they follow correctly.
re: Reactivation Game: 'Musical Statues' - Play Moroccan music, children dance when music stops, freeze. Teacher calls out an S1 word (e.g., 'animal'), children must act like that animal.
prod: Production Task: 'My Mini-Poster' - Children draw a picture of their favorite S1 topic (family, food, pets) and write 2-3 sentences (e.g., 'This is my family. We are happy. I have a cat.'). Present to the class.
rw: Reading and Writing Slot: 'Read and Answer' - Children read a short paragraph about a Moroccan festival (e.g., 'Independence Day is in November. People celebrate.'). Then answer 3 questions (e.g., 'When is it?') in simple sentences.
st: Story / Song + Goodbye: 'Goodbye Song' (to the tune of 'Twinkle Twinkle') - 'Goodbye friends, goodbye friends, see you next time, goodbye friends.' Props: Sticker chart. Goodbye routine: Goodbye Song + sticker chart + high-five line.
g: Teams race to shout the word on the flashcard.
Match picture cards with word cards.
Dance and freeze when music stops, act out a word.
Draw and write about a topic to present.
Read a short text and answer questions.
diff: Fast finishers: Write 3 extra sentences about their mini-poster.
Support: Use sentence starters like 'This is...' for the writing task.
hw: Homework 1: Draw a picture of your home and label 5 things in English.
Homework 2: Write 5 sentences about your favorite food.
Homework 3: Ask your family 3 questions in English and write the answers.
tip: Use the sticker chart to motivate kids during assessment week—stickers for effort, not just correct answers. Connect tasks to local culture (Eid, Green March) to make learning relevant.
checklist: I can say 10+ S1 words correctly.
I can follow 3-step instructions in English.
I can describe a picture in English.
I can answer simple questions about a story.
I can play a game using S1 language.
I can present my mini-poster to the class.
